title: Front-running `unlockDeposit()` can avoid loss distribution
summary: _Acknowledged_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When users deposits token with a lock, the code gives them bonus shares, and after the lock expires, the bonus is socialized among the share token holders in function `unlockDeposit()`: ```solidity         int256 accPnlDelta = d.assetsDiscount.mulDiv(PRECISION_18, totalSupply(), Math.Rounding.Ceil).toInt256();          accPnlPerToken += accPnlDelta;         if (accPnlPerToken > maxAccPnlPerToken().toInt256()) {             revert NotEnoughAssets();         }          lockedDepositNft.burn(depositId);
